title: File:Thompson mirror galvanometer use.png
author: Norman Hugh Schneider and Silvanus P. Thompson
credit: Downloaded from Norman H. Schneider (1913) Electrical Instruments and Testing, Spon & Chamberlain, New York, p.13 fig.8 and Thompson, Silvanus P. (1881) Elementary Lessons in Electricity and Magnetism, Macmillan, London, p.169, fig.91 on Google Books
description: Drawing of a Thomson reflecting galvanometer from around 1880, showing use. The vertical tube contains a fine silk fiber, which suspends a 1/2 in. mirror with small magnets on its back, seen in window
